best_idea: Crossfade every bed by reusing matching loops and fading by dt over fade time, and keep the current zone until a strictly nearer one is in range, so zone borders do not flicker.
decision_why: The bed crossfade and the holder rule fit a zones-as-data client; the sphere and line-of-sight pick stays client-side because sound is client-only, and the positional pop and sticky-last-bed defects are fixed in our version.
acceptance: A player crossing from a cave bed into open grass hears the cave loop fade out over 3 s while the grass loop fades in with no pop, and standing on a zone border does not swap beds back and forth.
